mcqs.question: The 3rd Sagarmanthan — The Great Oceans Dialogue 2026 was held at which venue and during which period?
mcqs.explanation: The 3rd Sagarmanthan — The Great Oceans Dialogue 2026 was held in New Delhi from 7–9 October 2026. The tempting alternatives incorrectly shorten the event to a single day or omit the year.

mcqs.question: The 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave 2026 was attended by approximately how many participants and from how many countries?
mcqs.explanation: The 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave had 180+ participants from ~30 countries. The closest distractor, 180 participants from ~30 countries, wrongly omits the ‘+’, while the others reverse or alter the figures.
